LAUNCHDARKLY_SDK_KEY.description: LaunchDarkly says to keep SDK keys secret and that an exposed one can be rotated. The name is convention: the SDKs take the key as an argument.

LAUNCHDARKLY_MOBILE_KEY.description: LaunchDarkly says mobile keys do not need to be kept secret.

LAUNCHDARKLY_CLIENT_SIDE_ID.description: LaunchDarkly says client-side ids need not be secret, and that unlike the others they cannot be rotated.
